{{Top|leg}}
'''Comm channel 7349.2''' was a communications channel utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The channel was monitored in [[System M132L4]] as part of [[Drop Point: Condor]], and could be accessed by Alliance [[operative]]s using [[encryption code N21-H]].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
